items.en_title: Ponto dos Volantes (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 28 #009
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Ponto dos Volantes (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,273,800; proposals close Nov 28, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
